Players Committee card image of [[Death Star II: Chasm Walkway]] (the same image re-uploaded turned 90°; part of that version, not a separate one; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' While Luke alone here, he is power +2.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/5794ee2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/large/deathstariichasmwalkway.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/large/deathstariichasmwalkway.gif] as of commit 5794ee2 “image updates” (10 November 2020).
